title: Remote Manipulation of a Capsule Endoscope
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to learn about the feasibility of moving a pill-sized camera (Givens Capsule) remotely in the esophagus and stomach using an external hand held magnet.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Asymptomatic adult volunteer with previously determined normal esophagus and stomach who understands the risks of the procedure.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known strictures in the intestine,
* Crohn's disease,
* Swallowing difficulty,
* Age less than 21,
* Age over 75 or have a pacemaker,
* Presence of implanted metal devices,
* Presence of esophageal or bowel disease or conditions that may preclude study participation as a matter of clinical judgment.
